segments.text: Umi can, ahamki asbiz ingilisini bilganin uchun lavazimeyam oqishti, maqishiyam kotarildi, siz bozi xalayam oqitiribsis.
Bani techi razam 13-lik tajirbegi ege ingilisira oqtutsiman, va 22-ci, 23-ci, 24-ci, 21-ci kunlare Bepul online masterclass taqshkirilashdirmakhtiman.

Uxbu masterclassda 0-dan 30-kun uchidi kundalik mavzurlardigi yapirishni, kunigi elikdige cham sozlarini ansonyotlap, realxayotlishatish, va ba 2-di darajadigi sertifikatini alishlin samarali yollarini orgetiman.
Masterclass da qatnash mund lakabey, pul faqad xabarwamustu qibasob royo qatnamotin,
wa yaa pqsirigam kanalimgi, qoshil barim.
